description: This file defines the API for ADPCM encoding and decoding, including data types, structures for decoder state and statistics, and function prototypes for creating, analyzing, decoding, resetting, and destroying ADPCM decoders.

methods.name: adpcm_decode_create
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new ADPCM decoder.

methods.name: adpcm_deframe
methods.description: Removes framing from an ADPCM packet.

methods.name: adpcm_analyze
methods.description: Analyzes an ADPCM packet for packet loss, header mismatches, and decoder failures.

methods.name: adpcm_decode
methods.description: Decodes an ADPCM frame into PCM samples.

methods.name: adpcm_decode_stats
methods.description: Retrieves decoding statistics from the decoder.

methods.name: adpcm_decode_reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder state and statistics.

methods.name: adpcm_decode_destroy
methods.description: Destroys and releases resources for the decoder.
